subject: Hosted vs Dedicated — latency/throughput decision follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finpay.com>, Lily Zhang <lily@finpay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted vs Dedicated — latency/throughput decision follow-up

Hi Samir / Lily,

Great speaking with you today — thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can converge on the right deployment mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated capacity):

Summary of requirements (as discussed):
- P95 latency target: <= 120 ms for the critical payments flow
- Peak throughput: ~200 requests/sec (spiky during batch settlement windows)
- Typical request size: 300-600 tokens (mostly short prompts + context)
- Security: FinPay will need audit logging and IP allowlist; full VPC or Dedicated preferred if we need stronger isolation

Options and recommendation (high-level):
1) Hosted API PoC — fastest to validate real-world latency with a sampled production traffic replay. If we can meet the P95 target on hosted, you keep operational simplicity.
2) Dedicated capacity — recommended if we cannot achieve the P95/throughput targets on hosted without increased cost or if you require stronger isolation/QoS guarantees. We can size a dedicated pool to target 200-250 rps with headroom.
3) Private VPC/on-prem — usually a later-stage ask for compliance; we can scope separately if required.

Next steps I recommend (action items):
- We run a 1-week hosted PoC using a sampled traffic replay (you provide sample traces/representative payloads).
- If hosted doesn't meet SLOs, we move to a dedicated sizing exercise (Neha will propose node counts and pricing).
- FinPay to share IP ranges for allowlist and any SOC/controls checklist items to validate.

Attachments: I attached a quick sizing workbook and our network diagram for the PoC (redwood-dedicated-sizing.pdf, network-diagram.png).

Can you confirm you can share a 24-48 hour sample of traffic and a good time for the PoC to start next week?

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

---
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform for LLMs

From: Samir Patel <samir@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lily Zhang <lily@finpay.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 18:27:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hosted vs Dedicated — latency/throughput decision follow-up

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:
- Our strict requirement is that P95 <= 120 ms for the payment-authorization path; P50 can be lower but we care about tail latency.
- Peak sustained windows can hit ~200 rps for 10-20 minute batches; average daily traffic is ~30 rps.
- We can provide a 48-hour sample of production traffic (sanitized) and a replay harness.
- Security: while isolation is important, we are open to starting with Hosted PoC to validate latency before committing to Dedicated. If PoC shows higher tail latency on Hosted, we will prioritize Dedicated.

Questions:
1) For the hosted PoC, what level of traffic injection will you run? Will it be sampled or full-rate?
2) What's your expected timeline to turn around initial results?
3) If we move to Dedicated, what ballpark node count / GPU type do you anticipate for 200 rps?

If you can send proposed test plan and a rough cost estimate for Dedicated sizing, we can review with procurement.

Thanks —
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, FinPay
samir@finpay.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finpay.com>, Lily Zhang <lily@finpay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted vs Dedicated — latency/throughput decision follow-up

Thanks Samir — answers inline and next steps below.

On Thu, Jul 1, 2027 at 6:27 PM Samir Patel <samir@finpay.com> wrote:
> 1) For the hosted PoC, what level of traffic injection will you run? Will it be sampled or full-rate?

We'll start with a sampled replay using your 48-hour trace at 10-25% injection to validate latency characteristics and identify any request patterns that cause KV cache churn. If results look promising, we'll increase to ~50% for a shorter window to validate p95 under higher load. We won't route live traffic unless you greenlight full cutover.

> 2) What's your expected timeline to turn around initial results?

We can run the initial sampled PoC within 3 business days of getting sample traces and IP allowlist. Initial latency/throughput report within 48 hours after the run.

> 3) If we move to Dedicated, what ballpark node count / GPU type do you anticipate for 200 rps?

Neha (cc'd) will provide the detailed sizing and ballpark costs, but ballpark: 3-4 x A100-class or equivalent GPU nodes (configured with autoscale headroom) to target 200-250 rps with P95 in the 80-120 ms range depending on model and quantization. We'll include warm KV cache configuration and batching knobs to reduce tail latency.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- You share sanitized 48-hour traffic traces + IP allowlist by EOD Monday.
- We schedule the PoC for the following Wednesday (sample run) — Marissa to coordinate timing.
- Neha will turn around sizing and a draft SOW for Dedicated if required.

Neha — can you prepare a short sizing doc and ballpark pricing we can share with FinPay this morning?

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted vs Dedicated — latency/throughput decision follow-up

Hi Samir / Marissa —

I put together a brief sizing and ballpark pricing for FinPay based on the numbers discussed. Attaching the short worksheet (redwood-dedicated-sizing.pdf). Key callouts:

Estimated Dedicated sizing (ballpark):
- Recommended pool: 4 x A100-equivalent GPU nodes (reserved with autoscale to 5 for bursts)
- Expected throughput: 220-260 rps (with per-request P95 ~ 90-110 ms for your payload profile, assuming quantized model and tuned batching)
- Warm KV cache + prefix caching to reduce cold-start tail latency

Ballpark pricing:
- Monthly committed cost (reserved): $XX,XXX–$YY,YYY depending on commitment term and burst configuration (I'll provide exact numbers in the SOW).

Operational asks for PoC:
- Provide sanitized 48-hour trace and example payloads + IP ranges for allowlist
- Provide list of model variants and max sequence lengths used in production

Next steps:
- If FinPay signs a short PoC agreement, we can run the hosted replay next Wednesday and deliver results within 48 hours of completion.
- If PoC shows P95 > 120 ms, we'll move directly to a Dedicated trial with a temporary reserved pool for testing (SOW + short-term billing).

HubSpot: I've created the record for this opportunity — https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/FinPay (HubSpot deal ID: 12345-FP). I'll follow up with a draft SOW and pricing sheet by EOD.

-Neha

neha@redwood.ai
